imageAlt.description: Alt text for the photo. Pass an empty string when it is decorative.

title.description: Main line in the glass panel, such as a name or a product.

aside.description: Small element at the end of the header, such as a price, a rating, or a status.

children.description: Detail content revealed when the card expands. Buttons inside stay interactive and do not toggle the card.

onOpenChange.description: Called when the card expands or collapses.

tilt.description: Maximum tilt in degrees. 0 turns tilt off.
